examples.arabic: الام كانت تعبانة كثير بس جاوبته بابتسامة
examples.english: The mother was very tired but answered him with a smile.
examples.transliteration: el em kanet taabane ktiir bas jawabto bebtisame

examples.arabic: الام جاوبته بهدوء بس ليث ضل يسأل عن العاصفة والرياح القوية
examples.english: His mother answered him calmly but Laith kept asking about the storm and the strong winds.
examples.transliteration: El em jawabto bi hudoo bas Laith dall yis'al an el aasifa w er-riyah el qawiyyeh.

examples.arabic: الام بتجاوب بتعب شوي بس بصبر يا حبيبي هيك كلنا بنعمل لنروح على شغلنا ومدارسنا
examples.english: The mother answers with a little tiredness but with patience: "My darling, this is how we all do it to go to our work and schools."
examples.transliteration: El-umm btijaweb bi ta'ab shway bass bi saber ya habibi heek kullna bni'mal la nrouh 'ala shoghlna w madarisna

examples.arabic: الام قالت انا منيحة شكرا حبيبي
examples.english: The mother said: "I'm fine, thank you my dear."
examples.transliteration: Al-omm qālat: Ana mnīḥa shukran habibi.

examples.arabic: حضرت الأم أطيب وصفة من أكلة المقلوبة بالمطبخ مع جو مليء بالمحبة والضحك
examples.english: The mother prepared the tastiest recipe of makloubeh in the kitchen with an atmosphere full of love and laughter.
examples.transliteration: HaDDr-at il umm aTyab waSfe min aklet il maqloobeh bil maTbakh ma3 jaww malee' bil maHabbeh w il DaHek

examples.arabic: الام ابتسمت وقالت صباح النور حبيبتي اهلا وسهلا
examples.english: The mother smiled and said, "Morning of light, my darling, welcome!"
examples.transliteration: Al-umm ibtasamat w qālat "Sabāḥ an-nūr ḥabībti ahlan wa sahlan."
